decisions.reason: This door lever handle family is close to the core range and was still listed in 2019, while comparable lines A and E were already removed. It likely meets aspirations, so with slack in a large firm it is kept, though there is some risk of range consolidation.

A single handle design within the established offer that survived the 2019 pruning carries low cost to maintain, so without evidence of a shortfall management keeps it rather than start problemistic search.

The electronic access system is a flagship aligned with the firm's strategic move toward digital building organization and was upgraded to a Pro version in 2019, so slack and strategic aspirations favour continuing it even if its results are still uncertain.
